private_constraints.name: code_recovery_check1
private_constraints.definition: CHECK (COALESCE((((payload ->> 'envelopeVersion'::text) = '1'::text) AND ((payload ->> 'algorithm'::text) = 'AES-256-GCM'::text) AND (key_version ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}$'::text) AND (nonce ~ '^[a-f0-9]{24}$'::text) AND ((payload ->> 'ciphertext'::text) ~ '^[a-f0-9]{12}$'::text) AND ((payload ->> 'tag'::text) ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$'::text)), false))

private_constraints.name: n88_membership_active_projection
private_constraints.definition: CHECK ((active = ((status = 'active'::text) AND (end_date IS NULL) AND student_active AND class_active)))

private_constraints.name: numeric_credentials_format_fields
private_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((payload - ARRAY['id'::text, 'ownerId'::text, 'studentId'::text, 'version'::text, 'reservation'::text, 'verifier'::text, 'keyVersion'::text, 'revokedAt'::text, 'format'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((NOT (payload ? 'format'::text)) OR COALESCE(((payload ->> 'format'::text) = 'six-v1'::text), false))))

private_constraints.name: numeric_rates_epoch_shape
private_constraints.definition: CHECK (((payload ?& ARRAY['key'::text, 'count'::text, 'until'::text]) AND ((payload - ARRAY['key'::text, 'count'::text, 'until'::text, 'epoch'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((NOT (payload ? 'epoch'::text)) OR COALESCE(((payload ->> 'epoch'::text) ~ '^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'::text), false))))
